correctness.rationale: For every left-permutative radius-one Boolean rule the inverse bit is uniquely determined by the output and a two-bit successor pair, yielding an exact four-state transformation. Ring-preimage existence for output repetition m is equivalent to a fixed point of its m-th power, hence its minimal factor is the shortest cycle length. Exhaustive closure of the 16 complete finite transformation monoids and all reachable augmented-language states proves the precise rulewise exceptional conditions for words of unbounded length, not merely finite experiments. The independent forward-image enumeration of lengths 1..12 exactly agreed for 5120 target/repetition tests; standalone Python checker terminated VERIFY_OK. The theorem does not assert primitive least spatial period.

value.rationale: Minimum enlargement of a spatially periodic output to admit a periodic one-step preimage is a natural finite-ring reachability invariant of surjective cellular automata. The exact global classification proves sharp maximal factors one, two, three or four and distinguishes nonlinear uniform-word mod-three obstructions from linear word-parity mod-four obstructions, with exact tests and witnesses for every rule. This classwise all-output rigidity theorem provides nontrivial structural information beyond one-off execution of a generic per-target algorithm.
